items.title: Daryl Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2024
items.q: The interviewee mentions Doc Cheatham only in the context of describing Chuck Folds' activities: 'playing with Doc Cheatham down in the Village regularly off the steady gig on Sundays.'

ctx.x: It’s not your piano, although I wouldn’t mind having that piano, but really what I’m referring to is you have a steady gig.

Well a lot of people have a steady gig but yes. And I started having steady gigs when I moved here. And it wasn’t until later that I understood what a one-nighter was about. I got spoiled very early on. But if you want me to tell you about this gig, it’s kind of funny that it should come to this, but I couldn’t be more grateful. It is a building atrium on Park Avenue between 52nd and 53rd, and all of those buildings are banks and usually really high-end investment companies and then restaurants, but mostly very…
